title: Static Grounded-Loop Raised-Hood Cobra
description: One complete newly authored stylised static cobra-like snake. Its tapered tail and low curved loop rest on finite flattened underside facets; the same continuous closed skin rises from the loop into a broad thick laterally spread neck hood, then narrows into a small rounded head. Hood, head, neck, loop and tail share full mesh rings, not a separate leaf or plate attached to an old snake. The hood has actual broad material width and real thickness, two small eyes are seated in the forward head; belly and dorsal colors are integral faces. Not the old horizontal S snake with more turns or simply raised path points. One static model, zero scenes; no exact species, venom/danger identification, animal behaviour, defence mechanism, biology, rig, movement or handling claim.
